title: Representation-Matched q-Sensitivity: Reproducibility Archive for Rank Changes and Winner Robustness in Orthopair Fuzzy Models
description: Curated code and certificate archive accompanying Representation-Matched q-Sensitivity: Rank Changes and Winner Robustness in Orthopair Fuzzy Models. It includes the recoverable seven-case benchmark, Qin and He checks, and the V17 Seikh integer-interval and MPFR certificate/witness evidence retained in manuscript V18. The Seikh comparison proves rho_src(4) <= 0.02321968 < 0.0235 <= rho_src(16) in the same normalized-baseline-raw L-infinity geometry; these are bounds, not exact radii or a claim of monotonicity for all q. The uniform finite-real-q>=4 bracket is 0.019 <= rho_src <= 0.02321968. The archive inventory distinguishes fresh replays from inherited evidence and missing historical records. Publisher PDFs and binaries, respondent-level third-party data, and internal development archives are not redistributed. The historical 30-record candidate-state ledger remains unavailable.
